pr.body:
#### Trac ticket number

ticket-37212

#### Branch description
<!-- Provide a concise overview of the issue or rationale behind the proposed changes. Minimum five words. -->

Additional cleanup work on djangodocs Sphinx extension:
* Remove unused regular expression.
* Add tests covering all functionality still in the extension.
* Resolve a deprecation that would break console tabs in Sphinx 11 (using the new tests to provide confidence about the fix).
